file: 386 Hatsune Miku Is Not a Real Person.mp4

lines.t: Hatsune Miku sells out concerts. But she's not a real person.

full.credit: Clips: Project DIVA Mega Mix+ (fgw); VALtheVAL (YouTube)

lines.t: She's singing software. Released on August 31st, 2007.

full.credit: Clips: Project DIVA Mega Mix+ (fgw); VALtheVAL (YouTube)

lines.t: Her voice comes from a real voice actress, Saki Fujita. Picked after about 500 auditions.

full.credit: Clips: Project DIVA Mega Mix+ (fgw); VALtheVAL (YouTube)

lines.t: Her name means the first sound from the future. Now she's even in Fortnite.

full.credit: Clips: Project DIVA Mega Mix+ (fgw); VALtheVAL (YouTube)

lines.t: Did you know Miku was software?

full.credit: Clips: Project DIVA Mega Mix+ (fgw); VALtheVAL (YouTube)
